review.body: { let literal = self . literal (& input . wall) ? ; let wall = self . computed (& literal) ? ; let price = match (input . floor , input . ridge . as_deref ()) { (Floor :: RidgeImage , Some (evidence)) => self . charged_price_with_ridge (& wall , & input . numeraire , evidence , verifier) ? , (Floor :: RationalThreeThirtySevenths , None) => self . charged_price (& wall , & input . numeraire , input . floor) ? , _ => return Err (NumericError :: RidgeEvidence) , } ; if price . price () . exact () != input . price { return Err (NumericError :: RidgeEvidence) ; } Ok (price) }
